==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Everyone lives in an underground tunnel system. The tunnels resemble a futuristic shopping mall. The tunnels are not particularly clean.
There are strict curfews enforced that limit tunnel travel. People are forced to live together in large groups. It is difficult to regularly spend time with friends.
My favorite past time is a mobile, superhero RPG. Despite living in a dystopia, I still manage to have fun playing the game. Survival is a struggle, but that won't stop me from having fun.
